+"""Write documents in the canonical layout."""
+
+from lamina.model import Blank, Comment, Document, Entry
+
+
+def dumps_canonical(doc, *, indent=0, skip=[]):
+    skip.append(doc.source)
+    padText = " " * indent
+    lines: list[str] = []
+    for section in doc.sections():
+        lines.append(f"[{section.name}]")
+        for item in section.items:
+            if isinstance(item, Entry):
+                lines.append(f"{padText}{item.key} = {item.value}")
+            elif isinstance(item, Comment):
+                lines.append(item.text)
+            elif isinstance(item, Blank):
+                lines.append("")
+    return "\n".join(lines) + ("\n" if lines else "")

+from lamina.loader import loads
+from lamina.dump.canonical import dumps_canonical
+
+
+def test_canonical_indents():
+    assert dumps_canonical(loads("[a]\nx = 1\n"), indent=2) == "[a]\n  x = 1\n"
+
+
+def test_canonical_keeps_comments():
+    assert "# c" in dumps_canonical(loads("[a]\n# c\nx = 1\n"))
+
+
+def test_canonical_empty():
+    assert dumps_canonical(loads("")) == ""
